notes: Validated against Russo Krauss et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2012 (doi:10.1093/nar/gks1001) and Padmanabhan & Tulinsky 1996 Acta Crystallogr D. T6/HD1 is a 15-mer DNA G-quadruplex aptamer (thrombin-binding aptamer, TBA). SPECIAL CASE: T6 is the LIGAND (DNA aptamer), thrombin protein is the RECEPTOR — reversed from the typical riboswitch setup. BINDING MECHANISM: The aptamer's TT loops dock into exosite I (fibrinogen-recognition exosite) of thrombin. Primary contacts (literature numbering): Arg75 and Tyr76 hydrophobic pocket with TT loop thymines; Arg77A salt bridge to Gua2 backbone phosphate; Asn78 H-bonds thymine N3; Ile79 hydrophobic. Secondary contact: Arg97 cation-π with TGT loop Thy9. The G-quartet is mostly solvent-exposed; electrostatic interactions dominate. 2026-06-03: receptor residues updated from literature names (Arg:75, Tyr:76, Arg:77A, Asn:78, Ile:79, Leu:65, Arg:97) to PDBQT-detected residues (I:664/LYS, I:666/ASP, I:667/LYS). Literature uses mature thrombin numbering (65-97 range); prepared PDBQT uses PDB residue numbering (660-670 range). LigandAtoms narrowed to P only (phosphate phosphorus — MacVina detects P contacts to protein sidechain atoms). The three detected phosphate contacts (A:6:P→I:667, A:7:P→I:666, A:17:P→I:664) cover the TT-loop-to-exosite-I interface. This is the only aptamer/protein case in the dataset — a category where no GPU-accelerated docking tool currently exists.
